author: Jorge Camacho

adaptation.selection: First straight body and upper eight fasteners; selected triangle vertex IDs below 562.
adaptation.blind_cap: Removed by the cut. Two unchanged nested star-shaped contours receive a checked annular closure; no bore plug or convexified contour.
adaptation.attributes: Retained source UVs and normalized normals. New cut vertices interpolate source attributes. Separate authored cut UVs and hard outward normals.
adaptation.normalization: Translate by the authored flange datum; retain source Y; uniformly scale all coordinates. Two copies mate using a proper half-turn about X.

pipe-fit/textures/modular_industrial_pip.role: The byte-identical original Group 01 albedo used by the prepared pipe kit and this coupling.

preparation.albedo: Original provider 1024-pixel sRGB JPEG; no resize or re-encoding.
preparation.linear_maps: Float Lanczos resize to 512 pixels; normalize OpenGL vectors, round to RGB8 and use lossless WebP with exact prepared-pixel equality. Packed channels remain red occlusion, green roughness and blue metallic.
preparation.source_material: Original double-sided shading, unit factors, original UV mapping and no normal-axis flip.

assembly.authority: Only explicit native coaxial engagement rows between a confirmed shaft and cog.
assembly.direction: Towards shaft interior; refuse placement without full original shaft span.
assembly.motion: Both halves follow the existing shaft cosmetic phase; no independent clock or new native contact.
assembly.preserved: Native centres, axes, dimensions, gear bores, picks, collision, quantities and saved state.

limits: Presentation only. This is an adapted industrial flange, not a provider mechanical socket or fluid feature. Raw captured resources and isolated invented-projection fit checks do not establish rendered quality, GPU cost, contact force, general machine routing or human acceptance.
